selected_restore_order.finding: Load produces GameState data; startup compares current StageController stage before applying stored player pose via Warp. Stage mismatch updates stored stage instead.
Startup callback selects OnLoadData unless DebugController.IsForceCreateNpc requests repopulation; eligible saved NPC records are queued individually.
Stage-completion path selects portal spawn pose, warps player and requests fresh NPC repopulation; it is distinct from saved-record restore.

Dropped-item cache construction/activation reads IsDropped and stage; matching records invoke Drop, other-stage dropped records invoke Hide, and not-dropped records are untouched by this selected loop.
Reserved drop callback checks stage, clears IsReserve, selects a random placement, drops/registers compass target and returns success for removal from pending list.
Delayed initialization broadcasts ChangeBodyEvent to selected generic typed listeners; bone adjustment defers an additional frame.
Default loadout factories create20 entries, while the selected load compatibility loops pad through index20; covered samples contain21 entries in both lists.
